title: Copying configuration
statement: Let $z$ and $x$ be Boolean lists, let $i_0,n,h$ be natural numbers, and assume $i_0+h\le |z|$. The associated two-work-tape machine configuration has input $z$, copy state, input-head position determined by $i_0+h$, value tape initialized from the first $h$ entries of $x$, mark tape true at integer positions in the interval $[h,n)$ and blank elsewhere, work-head position $h$, and empty output.
caveat: The definitions of the configuration-building functions and tape encodings are absent, so the precise input-head and tape-construction conventions are not supplied.
